senses.gloss: m. (אָזַר) girth, strap of cloth which is wound over the bed to keep the covering in position, Maim.; [Hai G. a. Ar.: (fr. מזר to spread under) a sort of carpet under the mattress; v., however, Tosef. quot. bel.].—
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 19:3">Kel. XIX, 3</cite> <he>מ׳ היוצא וכ׳</he> a piece of the girth hanging from the bed.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 19:3">Ib.</cite> <he>שירי מ׳</he> remnants of a torn girth. Ib. 4 <he>נישא … ועל המ׳</he> was carried (in his bed) by the bed and by the girth (the carriers holding the ends of the strap). Ib. 5, sq.; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 9:6">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IX, 6</cite>. <he>מ׳ שהוא מכרך בו וכ׳</he> the girth which one ties around the bed.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 9:6">Ib.</cite> <cite ref="M00785"><he>מזרין</he></cite> ed. Zuck. (corr. acc.).
